detail: Adding a tool section without updating all three pins fails CI. Sections need <!-- tier: N --> after the ### twining_* heading and the exact #### heading set; tier-1 sections additionally require Correct Usage / Incorrect Usage fenced blocks (see behaviors-parser.ts).
summary: BEHAVIORS.md is machine-parsed: the tool count is pinned in test/eval/types.ts (zod .length) and twice in behaviors-parser.test.ts — all three moved 32→35
